info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Careers Applications Interviews-v3-spec
info.description: The Careers Interview Applications API provides a system for retrieving a list of interview applications associated with various job openings. This endpoint allows recruiters and hiring managers to access and manage applicant information efficiently. By fetching detailed information about interview applications, users can streamline their hiring processes and improve candidate management. Typical consumers include HR teams and recruitment software systems that aim to enhance their candidate assessment workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of interview applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all interview applications associated with the system, providing necessary details for each application. Use this to review candidate interviews efficiently.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching interview applications. This body should contain parameters that specify the details of the interview applications you want to retrieve.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning interview application data.
